class Point {
  constructor(x: number) {
    this.x = x;
  }
}
const p = new Point(1);
p["y"] = 2;
p.y += 1;
const u: { a: number } | { b: string } = { a: 1 };
u.a = 2;
const r: Record<string, number> = {};
r.total = 3;
r["count"] = 4;
r.total = "five";
class Bag {
  [key: string]: number;
  constructor() {
    this.size = 0;
    this.name = "bag";
  }
}
const t = { a: 1 } as { a: number } | { a: string; b: number };
t.b = 1;
const o = { a: 1 };
o.b = 2;
console.log(p, u, r, new Bag(), t, o);
